name: app-onboarding-splash-dark-couple-illustration
title: Dark app splash screen with flat couple illustration
whatItIs: A single dark-background phone splash/registration screen, featuring a flat illustration of a couple at a café table surrounded by small confetti shapes, with a 'Lorem ipsum' headline and a 'Register now' pill button.
whatItMeans: A warm illustrated scene against an otherwise dark UI screen softens what could feel like a cold registration prompt, making the sign-up moment feel inviting rather than transactional.
techniques: center a warm illustrated scene within an otherwise dark, minimal UI screen for contrast
scatter small confetti/celebration shapes around the illustration to add lightness without clutter
use a single full-width pill button as the only interactive element for a focused call to action

vocabulary.definition: a brief introductory screen shown while an app loads or before a key action like registration
